src='''from itertools import combinations
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        for (r1,c1),(r2,c2) in combinations(pts,2):
            if r1!=r2 and abs(r2-r1)==abs(c2-c1):
                dr=1 if r2>r1 else -1; dc=1 if c2>c1 else -1
                r,c=r1,c1
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                    if out[r][c] not in (grid[0][0],color): pass
                    if out[r][c]==grid[0][0]: out[r][c]=color
                    r-=dr; c-=dc
                r,c=r1+dr,c1+dc
                while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w:
                    if out[r][c]==grid[0][0]: out[r][c]=color
                    r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out
'''
